title: Rulebook Completeness Domain Model Specification

familyStatusVocabulary.VERIFIED_COMPLETE: Every statutory clause for this family was audited and extracted from verified official documents.
familyStatusVocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE_VERIFIED: Official document explicitly confirms this family does not apply to this post track (e.g. "Experience: Nil").
familyStatusVocabulary.UNRESOLVED: Family has not been verified or audited against the official gazette/advertisement.

schema.isComplete: Boolean (true iff all required families are VERIFIED_COMPLETE or NOT_APPLICABLE_VERIFIED)

engineIntegration: evaluateCareerSignalPersonalization mandates rulebookCompleteness to produce final ELIGIBLE status.
